analysis.summary: Abhishek Sharma is a highly skilled ASP.NET MVC developer with experience in developing and deploying AI-powered applications using .NET, Azure, and SQL Server. He possesses strong skills in backend development, database design, and API integration.  He has a proven track record of delivering high-quality solutions and is proficient in various technologies.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-powered chatbot development using .NET, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
Strong database design and SQL Server expertise.
Experience with RESTful API design and integration.
Experience with data retrieval using LINQ joins.
weaknesses: Lack of experience with Azure DevOps.

suggestedImprovements.suggestion: Consider adding Kendo UI for UI component development and integration.
Expand on the AI Chatbot project, detailing the challenges faced and the solutions implemented in detail.
